THE ASK
Tournament art landed, but every tournament still feels like the same tournament.

ALL FIVE SHIPPED, each scoped to where it earns its cost:

A  land reveal — every card and the featured block, one-shot, 70ms stagger for the first three rows
C  press response — every card
D  hero parallax — the detail screen, plus a compact bar that gives it a back button that survives scrolling
B  Ken Burns — featured card and detail hero ONLY, banners only, never a list row
E  seeded shimmer — banner-less grounds only, as one skewed gradient band rather than a 200-view hairline field

B and E stop on screen blur. Everything stops under reduce-motion, and the design is complete with all of it off.

Live in src/lib/motion.ts, TournamentArt, TournamentCard, FeaturedTournament, TournamentHero and tournament/[id].tsx. Tokens are also written up in DESIGN.md §6.

FIVE OPTIONS, ONE AXIS EACH
One-shot · ambient · input-driven · scroll-driven · fallback-only.
Every card below is real geometry from TournamentCard.tsx and TournamentHero.tsx. Banner photos are CSS placeholders — the repo has no tournament photography yet.
